name: Rectus Femoris Avulsion Injury
definition: Avulsion or high-grade proximal rectus femoris injury, often near the AIIS in adolescents or at the direct/indirect tendon origins in athletes.

typical: Weak hip flexion or knee extension

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess adolescent bony avulsion; MRI defines tendon injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Large displaced avulsions or high-performance complete tears may need surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Snayu avulsion phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Avulsion or high-grade proximal rectus femoris injury, often near the AIIS in adolescents or at the direct/indirect tendon origins in athletes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
